{"code": "import numpy as np

# Calculate the change in biomarker from baseline to final
# Only include rows where both baseline and final values are present
df['change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Drop rows where either baseline or final is missing (i.e., NaN)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final'])

# Compute the mean change in biomarker levels
mean_change = df_clean['change'].mean()

# Compute the standard deviation of the change
std_change = df_clean['change'].std()

# Number of patients with complete data
n_complete = len(df_clean)

print(f"Mean change in biomarker: {mean_change:.2f} ng/mL")
print(f"Standard deviation of change: {std_change:.2f} ng/mL")
print(f"Number of patients with complete data: {n_complete}")"}
